_doc: Copy employers/_template/ to employers/<slug>/ (gitignored), fill this in, write <slug> into employers/ACTIVE, then run `python3 scripts/employer.py validate`. Keys starting with _ are comments. Full runbook: employers/README.md.

employer.name: Example Corp
employer._company_names: Lower-cased substrings that mark a person or account as 'us' (client-follow-through's gate).

providers._doc: One adapter per capability: mail google|m365, calendar google|m365|eventkit, files google|m365, chat slack|teams|none. Contracts: resources/adapters/<capability>.md. A loop whose adapter is not bound refuses to run.

runtime._doc: Which Claude login runs the loops. Keep it personal: an employer seat stops every loop when the job ends.

confidentiality._vault_ok: Dated approvals for this employer's content in the vault, e.g. {"chat": "2026-11-01"}. Empty = output/ only.

_files: Real config files of skills, filed as <skill-id>/<file>. Start each from the skill's schema/*.example.*.
_loops: launchd labels this employer's bindings feed, e.g. com.cbrain.mail-triage. `employer.py loops --load --apply` starts them.
